All BA students are required to complete the BA degree language requirements, for a total of 12 semester hours of language study or demonstrated equivalent proficiency, as described in Additional Requirements for BA students . Successful demonstration of proficiency does not reduce total minimum semester hours of study required to earn the BA degree.
All undergraduate students are required to complete the NUpath Requirements .

college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: This interdisciplinary combined major offers students an opportunity to integrate the study and practice of journalism with a study devoted to the critical and systemic examination of the cultural, political, social, economic, and historical experiences of the peoples of the global African diaspora. Through critical thinking and practical skills, the program engages students in a deep understanding of both disciplines,
